g.text: A mark with ink in it.
Three new silhouettes. Original vector outlines; print texture kept separate from the core mark.
Cut edges; a compact, assertive stamp.
An angled stroke with a little human tension.
Lettering first; the r belongs to the name.
A lifted shoulder on the r.
Drawn as a family; still an audition,
with spacing and curves to refine.
PRINT STUDY / OFFSET INK + BROKEN EDGES + PAPER FLECKS
Texture for larger artwork; clean outlines for tiny icons.
